demos.title: Operate BGP from the live dashboard
demos.description: Connect to Ze over SSH, open the live BGP dashboard, sort peers, and inspect one session.

demos.title: Create ZeFS and commit over SSH
demos.description: Create the ZeFS database, edit the active configuration through Ze's SSH management plane, and verify the committed setting.

demos.title: Prove read-only RBAC enforcement
demos.description: Run an allowed NOC command, then show Ze explicitly refuse a known state-changing command.

demos.title: Trace a live path without external services
demos.description: Run Ze's live traceroute through a deterministic Linux network-namespace lab.

demos.title: Discover Ze commands interactively
demos.description: Use type-ahead filtering and drill-down navigation in Ze's interactive command launcher.

demos.title: Edit and commit configuration in the browser
demos.description: Change a YANG-backed setting, review the generated diff, commit the draft, and verify the active value.

demos.title: Watch an unconfirmed change roll back
demos.description: Commit a hostname change in the interactive editor, leave the confirmation window unanswered, and verify Ze restores the previous configuration.

demos.title: Accept valid routes and reject RPKI-invalid ones
demos.description: Feed three local routes through a deterministic RTR cache, then show Valid and NotFound routes installed while the Invalid route is absent.

demos.title: Add IRR filtering to an existing BGP peer
demos.description: Populate a stored configuration with the IRR plugin, server, AS-SET, and import filter, then prove registered routes pass and unregistered routes do not.

demos.title: Follow a route from BGP RIB to Linux FIB
demos.description: Inject one route, inspect BGP best-path selection, and verify Linux installed it with Ze's route protocol ID. Validation also proves withdrawal removes it.

demos.title: Separate live warnings from recent errors
demos.description: Read aggregate component health, follow a live stale-prefix warning from the SSH banner into show warnings, then reset a peer and find the retained event in show errors.

demos.title: Render one configuration for humans and automation
demos.description: Show one BGP peer as hierarchical blocks and set commands, round-trip between both with identical canonical output, then compose match and count over Ze's plugin registry.

demos.title: Let BFD protect a live BGP session
demos.description: Establish BFD and BGP with a local FRR peer, cut the peer link, and verify BFD drives BGP down before protocol timers expire.

demos.title: Diagnose a missing OSPF route
demos.description: Inspect the active OSPF configuration, query the running control plane with Ze's CLI, trace a Full neighbor through the LSDB, and confirm the expected route.

demos.title: Attribute a live traffic burst
demos.description: Attach Ze's pure-Go eBPF accounting to a local veth, generate ICMP and HTTP traffic, and inspect source, protocol, port, and byte totals.

demos.title: Keep the gateway reachable while Ze stops
demos.description: Inspect the active and live VRRP state, stop the higher-priority Ze router, and prove keepalived takes the same reachable VIP.

demos.title: Inspect a Linux host before Ze starts
demos.description: Use Ze's offline command fallback to read the complete kernel, CPU, and memory inventory in human-readable structured output.

demos.title: Find every peer affected by a group change
demos.description: Inspect and validate a BGP group, then use Ze's dependency graph to prove which peers inherit the value before scheduling maintenance.
